editorial.blurb: Inspired Indian crafts exceptional sandwiches and heat-at-home dinners that pack huge, authentic flavors and arrive ready to love.
editorial.insiderTip: Order 'Heat at Home' dinners a couple days ahead via their website—the menu changes weekly. For pickup sandwiches, order online from campus and it'll be ready when you arrive.
